intended_object: This is a formal derivation, not an object. For every closed arithmetic term t (with its bound variables replaced by numerals for e), it builds a proof in the internalized theory T of the equation ⌜t⌝[numerals e] = numeral(value of t). This is the term-equation case of formalized Σ₁-completeness, used for Hilbert–Bernays–Löb derivability condition D3. I inferred this from the name, the type and the module D3.lean.
